Description: explicit — route shields missing badge on the open OpenMapTiles stack
prompt: I'm using an open OpenMapTiles / OSM-based vector basemap with MapLibre GL JS (no Mapbox account). My interstate and US highway shields render as bare floating numbers with no shield badge behind them; the numbers are fine. My tiles do populate network, ref, and ref_length. Which exact sprite image names do the shield layers expect, and how do I get the badges to appear without editing the layers?

Description: implicit — own icon sheet alongside the basemap provider's, icons never appear
prompt: My MapLibre GL JS style's sprite points at my basemap provider's URL. I host my own sheet of POI icons on my own domain, and I set icon-image on my symbol layer to one of my icon names. The basemap's own icons all render fine, but mine never appear and nothing logs an error. I'd rather not merge the two sheets or rebuild them. How do I get my symbol layers to reference the icons in my sheet?

Description: implicit — SVG category icons for a GeoJSON venue layer
prompt: MapLibre GL JS 6. I have about 40 category icons as SVG files served from my own site, and a GeoJSON source of roughly 5,000 venues, each with a `category` property. Every venue should show its category's icon, and zoomed out the icons shouldn't pile up on top of each other. Show me the code that loads the icons and draws the venues.

Description: anti-pattern — shield detection heuristic that ignores icon-text-fit
prompt: Reviewing my style-audit script. It flags a MapLibre symbol layer as a route shield when layer.layout['text-anchor'] === undefined and layer.layout['symbol-placement'] === 'point'. It is tagging plain place-name layers as shields and skipping real shield layers. Is the heuristic sound, and what should it key off instead?

Description: negative — a draggable pin with a popup stays a Marker
prompt: How do I place a draggable pin at a coordinate in MapLibre GL JS and show a popup when the user clicks it?
